body:
## Change

F1. Capture parsed nightly selection before scan, compare against fresh parsed selection afterward. Fail ASSET_SOURCE_CHANGED before writing inventory when selection changed during scan.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN changes synthetic selection during asset-root observation, checks failure and absence of inventory write. Parent reviewed check/write ordering, semantic canonical comparison and fixture restoration; reran 38 profile tests. Worker contracts: 87; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Common lock protects cooperating writers. Uncooperative edits after final reread remain outside this before/after check; no claim of filesystem transactionality. No live promotion/sync/publication. Full repo gates not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(assets): reject changed profile selection before sync write
